name: Campaign Replies
query:
SELECT
    d.replied_on as "Replied On:Datetime:160",
    d.lead as "Lead:Link/Lead:150",
    l.lead_name as "Lead Name::160",
    l.email_id as "Email::200",
    d.campaign as "Campaign:Link/Campaign:150",
    d.email_campaign as "Email Campaign:Link/Email Campaign:150",
    c.subject as "Reply Subject::260",
    d.reply_communication as "Reply:Link/Communication:150"
FROM `tabLexocrates Email Campaign Dispatch` d
LEFT JOIN `tabLead` l ON l.name = d.lead
LEFT JOIN `tabCommunication` c ON c.name = d.reply_communication
WHERE d.replied = 1
ORDER BY d.replied_on DESC
